title: The Meeting Place Cannot Be Changed
statementMd:
The main road in Bytecity is a straight line from south to north. Conveniently, there are coordinates measured in meters from the southernmost building in north direction.

At some points on the road there are $*n*$ friends, and $*i*$-th of them is standing at the point $*x*_{*i*}$ meters and can move with any speed no greater than $*v*_{*i*}$ meters per second in any of the two directions along the road: south or north.

You are to compute the minimum time needed to gather all the $*n*$ friends at some point on the road. Note that the point they meet at doesn't need to have integer coordinate.

## Input

The first line contains single integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 60 000$) — the number of friends.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the current coordinates of the friends, in meters.

The third line contains $*n*$ integers $*v*_{1}, *v*_{2}, ..., *v*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the maximum speeds of the friends, in meters per second.

## Output

Print the minimum time (in seconds) needed for all the $*n*$ friends to meet at some point on the road.

Your answer will be considered correct, if its absolute or relative error isn't greater than $10^{ - 6}$. Formally, let your answer be $*a*$, while jury's answer be $*b*$. Your answer will be considered correct if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/354edc27fee211170922d7a154f57d15b2eb8afb.png) holds.

## Note

In the first sample, all friends can gather at the point $5$ within $2$ seconds. In order to achieve this, the first friend should go south all the time at his maximum speed, while the second and the third friends should go north at their maximum speeds.
statementZhMd:
主干道是 Bytecity 中一条由南向北延伸的直线。方便起见，以最南端建筑为起点，沿向北方向用米来度量坐标。

道路上的某些位置站着 $*n*$ 位朋友，其中第 $*i*$ 位朋友位于距离起点 $*x*_{*i*}$ 米处，并且可以沿道路向南或向北以任意不超过 $*v*_{*i*}$ 米/秒的速度移动。

请计算让所有 $*n*$ 位朋友在道路上的某个位置集合所需的最短时间。注意，他们会面的地点的坐标不必是整数。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 60 000$），表示朋友的数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示朋友当前所在的位置坐标，单位为米。

第三行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*v*_{1}, *v*_{2}, ..., *v*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示朋友的最大速度，单位为米/秒。

## 输出格式

输出所有 $*n*$ 位朋友在道路上的某个位置会面所需的最短时间，单位为秒。

如果你的答案与标准答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则会被判定为正确。形式化地，设你的答案为 $*a*$，评测程序的答案为 $*b*$。当 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/354edc27fee211170922d7a154f57d15b2eb8afb.png) 成立时，你的答案将被判定为正确。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，所有朋友可以在 $2$ 秒内聚集到位置 $5$。为了实现这一点，第一位朋友应始终以最大速度向南移动，而第二位和第三位朋友应以最大速度向北移动。
